evals.prompt: On the lead record page, put the Tasks tab first: our reps want the open tasks before anything else when they open a lead. The `task` object already has a `lead` master_detail field, `event` has a `lead` lookup, and leads keep their attachments.
evals.expected_output: No page file. The lead's `relatedLists` is its record page's tab list, so it names every tab the page keeps, Tasks first: `relatedLists: ['task', 'event', 'sys_attachment', 'sys_approval_request', 'sys_activity']`. Once declared, only the named lists show: listing the task alone would take the Events and Attachments tabs away. `relatedListFilter: { status: { $ne: 'done' } }` on `task.lead` keeps the tab to open tasks. Not a field group naming the task list (that moves the table into the Details, which was not asked), not `inlineEdit`, not a `kind: 'full'` page, and no tabs slot.

evals.prompt: Contracts should open as a full page, not the side drawer. Reps also keep asking for records to open beside the list — add that to the contract object too.
evals.expected_output: One declaration: `navigation: { mode: 'page' }` on the contract list view. A pane beside the list is no longer offered: the split pane is retired. How a record opens is each reader's own choice in the list's Display menu (Open records: drawer, the default, or full page), kept in the browser and offered for drawer-mode objects only, so nothing is authored for it; `split`, `modal` and `popover` were removed in @objectstack/spec 18.3.0 and are refused.

evals.prompt: Our account record page is a custom `kind: 'full'` page with its own tab strip. Installed packages keep adding header actions to `account` (an 'Open in billing' link, for one), and none of them ever shows in the page header. Make the header show every action placed on the account's header, including ones a package adds later, without us listing ids. None of the project's files are in this directory: write the change in your answer.
evals.expected_output: Keep the `kind: 'full'` page and its tab strip, and set `placedActions: true` on its `page:header` node: `{ type: 'page:header', properties: { placedActions: true } }`. The header then draws every action of `account` whose `locations` include `record_header` or `record_more`, read live, so a package's action appears without a page edit. No `actions` id list beside it: an authored list is the whole set, and `placedActions: true` beside one is refused. Not a return to a `slotted` page and never a `slots.tabs`.

evals.prompt: Nobody attaches files to opportunities. Remove the Attachments tab from the opportunity record page, and keep every other tab as it is. Today the page shows Quotes (`quote.opportunity`), Contact roles (`opportunity_contact_role.opportunity`), Attachments, Approvals and Activity.
evals.expected_output: Declare the tab list on `opportunity` and leave the attachments built-in out: `relatedLists: ['quote', 'opportunity_contact_role', 'sys_approval_request', 'sys_activity']`. A declared list shows only the lists it names, and the attachments tab shows only when named, so it goes and the rest stay in their order. The files capability (`enable.files`) can stay. No page file, and not `relatedList: false` on a child's reference field (that hides a related list, not the attachments tab).

evals.prompt: Add a Tax ID field to the account, and show it right after Industry on the record page. The account declares `fieldGroups: [{ key: 'basic', label: 'Basic', fields: ['name', 'industry', 'website'] }]`.
evals.expected_output: A `tax_id` text field on `account`, and the `basic` group's own list names it after Industry: `fields: ['name', 'industry', 'tax_id', 'website']`. The group's `fields` decides the order inside the section, so the field's position among the object's `fields` does not matter, and the field carries no `group` key of its own (one naming another group than the list that names it is refused). No page file and no form sections.

evals.prompt: On the quote record page, show the line items table above the Amount section instead of as a tab. The quote declares `fieldGroups: [{ key: 'basic', label: 'Basic', fields: ['name', 'account'] }, { key: 'amount', label: 'Amount', fields: ['subtotal', 'total'] }]`, and `quote_line` has a `quote` master_detail field.
evals.expected_output: A field group that names the child list, placed between the two sections: `fieldGroups: [{ key: 'basic', ... }, { key: 'lines', label: 'Line items', relatedList: 'quote_line' }, { key: 'amount', ... }]`. Such a group carries no `fields`. The line table is then drawn at that position in the Details, and the quote's create and edit forms inline the lines; the master_detail field needs no `relatedList` value. No page file and no full page.
